test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence. 

These figures have been greatly __exaggerated__.
solution:
"The correct answer is option 2) **magnified.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "exaggerated" means to overstate or overemphasize something.
 
• The question asks for a synonym, which means a word with a similar meaning.
 
• Out of the given options, "magnified" is the closest in meaning to "exaggerated."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Understated" means to downplay or make something seem less important than it actually is.
 
• "Belittled" means to make someone or something seem unimportant or inferior.
 
• "Ignore" means to pay no attention to something or someone.
 
• It's important to choose the correct synonym in order to accurately convey the intended meaning of the sentence."
